GÖTTFERT – RCR Rubber Capillary Rheometer 
The RCR Rubber Capillary Rheometer has been developed for fast measurements and user-friendly operation to achieve particularly fast results in quality control applications.
RCR Rubber Capillary Rheometer 
Discover the RCR 75 – your ultimate tool for rubber materials! This capillary rheometer offers an impressive test force of 75 kN and focuses on delivering results at lightning speed, especially for quality testing. Get precise measurements in just 2-5 minutes – quickly and effortlessly!
In open extrusion mode, the RCR works as a conventional capillary rheometer and measures the viscosity at up to three different shear rates per run. It calculates the shear rate from the punch speed and the shear stress from the punch force.
The injection mode offers the option of injecting material under constant pressure into a separately heated injection mould. This gives you a precise characterisation of the flow behaviour and vulcanisation of rubber compounds in a realistic process.
The RCR also offers the option of measuring the viscosity of duromers such as epoxy or phenolic resins. A special channel with an easy-to-clean, split nozzle is available for this purpose, which makes handling particularly easy.
Features of the RCR Rubber Capillary Rheometer 
Nominal force 75 kN
Simulation of production and processing conditions
Test channel diameter 20, 30 or 35 mm
Test intervals of less than 3 minutes
High dynamics / acceleration.
Extrusion mode (up to 3 stamping speeds per filling) for determining the viscosity
Test execution and evaluation with “Rubberview” software
Injection mode (optional) with branching or spiral tool
Viscosity measurement on duromers with split capillary and special channel (optional)

Rheological testing equipment since 1962 
GÖTTFERT Werkstoff-Prüfmaschinen GmbH was founded in 1962 by Prof. Dr Otto Göttfert. In the second generation, his son, Dr Axel Göttfert, took over as sole managing director.
On the global market, this medium-sized company is recognised as one of the leading firms in the niche sector of rheological testing equipment. The innovative rheological systems are used worldwide in laboratories as well as in production.
